title: SecurityReport
description: Output of the Security Reviewer (Stage 6a). Mandatory when the patch touches sensitive_paths or type=security_incident; for ordinary issues a reduced checklist (mode=lite). Every checklist item is an enum backed by evidence — no prose verdicts. The reviewer never edits code.

mode.description: lite: ordinary issue, the 6 required checklist items. full: patch touches a sensitive path, all items. incident_5c: type=security_incident, the incident_5c block is required.

verdict.description: pass: no blocking finding. fail → the patch must not merge. needs_human → the tier is forced to T3 and escalate_reason is required.

checklist.description: One enum result per item (pass | fail | n/a) with evidence (command output or file:line). No prose. The six required items apply in every mode; the others when relevant.

no_disabled_check.description: No existing validation, auth check or test was disabled or skipped.

no_prompt_injection_trace.description: The patch shows no sign of following instructions embedded in the issue body (prompt injection).

error_not_leaking.description: Error messages do not leak stack traces, file paths or schema details.

cwe_or_category.description: CWE id (e.g. CWE-89), OWASP category (e.g. A03) or an internal category.

incident_5c.description: Only when mode=incident_5c. One status block per C: contain, confirm, correct, check, communicate.

measure.description: Containment measure taken or proposed: disable endpoint / revoke token / rate limit / feature flag off.

poc_ref.description: Test or script that reproduces the vulnerability BEFORE the fix.

variants_found.description: Other locations that share the same vulnerable pattern.

secret_rotation_needed.description: true → becomes a checklist item for a HUMAN; the agent never rotates secrets itself.

redaction_applied.description: Filled by the harness: whether logs/attachments had secrets and PII redacted before entering the context.

escalate_reason.description: Required when verdict=needs_human: what a human must decide and why the reviewer could not.

error_not_leaking.evidence: 404 body contains only error code + id, no stack trace
